apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: HTTPRoute
metadata:
  name: swiftdrop-routes
  namespace: swiftdrop
spec:
  parentRefs:
    - name: swiftdrop-edge
  hostnames: ["swiftdrop.example.com"]
  rules:
    - matches:
        - path: {type: PathPrefix, value: /api}
        - path: {type: PathPrefix, value: /ws}
      backendRefs:
        - {name: gateway, port: 8080}
    - matches:
        - path: {type: PathPrefix, value: /}
      backendRefs:
        - {name: web, port: 8080}
